question:
Simplify the given expression.

((8)/(125))⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾ times((27)/(64))⁻⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾ div((5)/(4))⁻²
solution:
**Given:**

((8)/(125))⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾ times((27)/(64))⁻⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾ div((5)/(4))⁻² [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ ((8)/(125))⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾ times((27)/(64))⁻⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾ div((5)/(4))⁻² 

⇒ ((2)/(5))³times{⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾} times((3)/(4))³ times {⁻⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾} div((5)/(4))⁻² 

⇒ ((2)/(5))² times((3)/(4))⁻² div((5)/(4))⁻² 

⇒ ((2)/(5))² times((4)/(3))² times((5)/(4))² 

⇒ 4/9

 

**Therefore the correct answer is 4/9.**
